caption: The drawing depicts three figures seated together at the top center, each with a green mantle and a green pointed headdress featuring a small cross at its crest. All three figures have brown skin, beards, and are dressed in long, white robes with vertical blue stripes. Their right hands are raised to their chests, and their left hands rest on their laps, with green objects (possibly cushions) behind them. The trio is seated on a large, light blue circular shape. Above them, there is a scalloped, maroon-red border, and behind it a sky-blue background fills the upper part of the composition. Below the central figures, three smaller, winged figures appear; they have red and orange wings, round faces, and are placed against a pale background. At the bottom of the frame, a larger winged figure with an orange body and wings, and a white face, is shown flying above a stylized depiction of clouds, drawn as black, segmented curves on a white ground. The entire scene is enclosed in a rectangular frame with a double line border, one black and one golden brown. The number "33" appears in small text at the bottom left corner outside the frame.
title: Plate 33: The Holy Trinity: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico
